items.change: Added Prisma schema loading through createSchemaPathInput/getSchemaWithPath and changed generated-client resolution to use the generator's configured output and extension, with fallback paths.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's prisma.config schema handling and prisma-client generator output replacing the implicit @prisma/client location.
items.required_rule: S: v7 schema loading via prisma.config and explicit generator output

items.change: GraphQL generation imports the generated client directly, handles Prisma's ESM/CJS export shapes, uses cache-busted file URLs, and reads schemas through the new project-config helper; db re-export detection now recognizes generated-client imports.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's generated client no longer being reliably available through @prisma/client and its changed schema-loading APIs.
items.required_rule: S: generated client is no longer at @prisma/client in v7

items.change: Added a Prisma client generation helper that invokes Prisma's CLI entry point with --config and detects whether a generated client already exists.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 requiring prisma.config and generating a client at a configured output path.
items.required_rule: S: v7 generates to a configured output and reads prisma.config

items.change: validateUniqueness no longer constructs a fallback PrismaClient and now throws when no db instance is supplied.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's generated client and adapter-based initialization, which prevents direct construction through @prisma/client.
items.required_rule: S: v7 requires an adapter, so a bare PrismaClient fallback cannot be built

items.change: Replaced direct use of Prisma internals' getSchemaPath/getSchemaWithPath with Cedar's getPrismaSchemas helper.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's changed schema-path API and support for multi-file/configured schemas.
items.required_rule: S/D: Prisma internals' schema-path API changed in v7

items.change: Made storage extension and upload configuration types generic over the generated Prisma client and used Prisma's extension Result type instead of importing PrismaClient and Prisma from @prisma/client.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's generated-client output and adapter-based client model.
items.required_rule: S: generated client replaces @prisma/client types

items.change: Updated storage tests to use the generated client with PrismaBetterSqlite3, moved the SQLite URL into prisma.config, changed the generator to prisma-client, generated the client during test setup, and removed the old Vitest client alias.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's prisma-client generator, required driver adapter, configured datasource URL, and changed generated-client location.
items.required_rule: S: adapter, prisma.config url and new generator required in v7 (tests)

items.change: Changed test database setup and teardown to use Prisma config/schema loading directly, removed schema-based directUrl rewriting and --skip-seed, and added support for .mts/.cts files and API path mappings.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 moving datasource configuration into prisma.config and using ESM/generated TypeScript clients.
items.required_rule: S: url and seeding flags moved/removed in v7 (--skip-seed removed)

items.change: dbAuth setup now loads schemas through getPrismaSchemas and its test schemas use prisma-client without a datasource URL in schema.prisma.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's schema-loading API and moving datasource configuration out of schema.prisma.
items.required_rule: S: schema url not accepted in v7

items.change: Externalized the SQLite adapter/native driver in Vite server builds and provided __non_webpack_require__ for external CommonJS native-driver loading.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 driver adapters bringing @prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3 and better-sqlite3 into the runtime.
items.required_rule: D: knock-on of the required SQLite driver adapter (native driver in Vite server builds)

items.change: Updated generated app templates to use prisma.config, prisma-client with explicit output, PrismaBetterSqlite3, generated-client imports, and SQLite URLs rooted at api/db.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's removed datasource url in schema.prisma, new generator, explicit output, and driver-adapter requirement.
items.required_rule: S: new apps from the templates would fail on v7 without config, adapter and output

items.change: Changed the default SQLite URL from file:./dev.db to file:./db/dev.db and documented the required migration.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's configured/generated-client layout causing CLI and runtime SQLite paths to diverge.
items.required_rule: D: CLI and runtime SQLite paths diverged under prisma.config

items.change: Generated services, data migrations, and GraphQL types now import Prisma types through src/lib/db rather than conditionally from @prisma/client.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's generated client no longer being exposed through the default @prisma/client entry.
items.required_rule: S: generated client is no longer at @prisma/client in v7

items.change: Updated documentation examples and commands for prisma.config, generated-client imports, Prisma 7 client initialization, adapters, and the new SQLite URL.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's configuration, generated-client, adapter, and SQLite-path changes.
items.required_rule: docs

items.change: Removed Prisma 6 compatibility branches: generated code always imports through src/lib/db, GraphQL codegen no longer falls back to @prisma/client, and generated-client resolution now returns the configured client path or an error.
items.responds_to: Cedar projects using Prisma 7 exclusively in canary builds and no longer needing the Prisma 6/default-client fallback.
items.required_rule: cleanup of Prisma 6 fallbacks after the move

items.change: Added a Prisma 7 migration codemod that moves datasource configuration to prisma.config, rewrites the generator and client imports, adds the SQLite adapter and initialization, updates package/config/ignore/env files, and rewrites remaining @prisma/client imports.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's removed schema datasource URL, new prisma-client generator, explicit generated output, driver adapters, and generated-client imports.
items.required_rule: new codemod for Cedar's users; the project itself runs without it

items.change: Extended the Prisma 7 codemod to detect PostgreSQL projects, add PrismaPg and @prisma/adapter-pg, construct the adapter from DATABASE_URL, pass it to PrismaClient, and add the PostgreSQL dependencies.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's driver-adapter architecture for PostgreSQL.
items.required_rule: codemod extension (new tooling)

items.change: Made codemod adapter insertion work when the generated-client import is absent or already rewritten, and centralized insertion of adapter properties across PrismaClient constructions.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 migration output variations and rerunning the adapter-based codemod.
items.required_rule: codemod improvement

items.change: Fixed codemod import placement and preserved leading file comments when inserting Prisma adapter imports.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 adapter-import insertion in existing db files.
items.required_rule: codemod fix

items.change: Added the Prisma 7 codemod to the 3.x upgrade-script checks so upgrades detect and run the migration.
items.responds_to: Cedar 3.x projects requiring the Prisma 7 source transformation.
items.required_rule: upgrade-script check for the optional codemod

items.change: Added Cedar env-file loading to Prisma 7 codemod/test and fixture commands, and passed --load-env-files user where prisma.config evaluates environment variables.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 prisma.config being executable configuration that requires environment variables to be loaded before Prisma operations.
items.required_rule: S: v7 does not load env files; prisma.config evaluates env vars in test setup and commands

items.change: Live-query PostgreSQL connections now read datasource.url from the loaded Prisma config and use it as the pg connection string, with an error when it is absent.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 moving the datasource URL from schema.prisma/environment handling into prisma.config.
items.required_rule: S: datasource url moved to prisma.config; live queries read it from the schema/env before

items.change: Loaded project environment variables before gqlorm generation.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 prisma.config requiring environment variables to be available while schema/client metadata is generated.
items.required_rule: S: v7 prisma.config needs env vars loaded before generation
